description.zh_CN: 通过 admin:exec 把 UFW 可信白名单（机队 IP + DDNS 家庭出口）与每台节点的公共端口集中同步到每台 agent；含节点选择/列表式白名单/逐节点公共端口 UI。默认 dry-run。
description.en: Centrally sync a UFW trusted whitelist (fleet IPs + DDNS home exits) and per-node public ports to every agent via admin:exec, with a node-selection / list-style whitelist / per-node public-port UI. Dry-run by default.
